journey.label: Professional Journey
journey.title: From Biotechnology to Agentic AI
paragraphs: My path began in biology — studying molecular dynamics, designing experiments, and publishing research at SCTIMST. The analytical discipline of science became the foundation for a career pivot into Data Science in 2023, rapidly evolving through machine learning, deep learning, and now Generative & Agentic AI systems.

Today I design and deploy Generative AI systems as a Gen AI Engineer at Blackbox Learning — building RAG pipelines, multimodal models, and agentic architectures — while continuing to educate the next generation of AI professionals.

teaching.description: I design and deliver AI curriculum covering ML, Deep Learning, and Generative AI — guiding 100+ students through placement mentorship and hands-on project work. My philosophy: technical excellence paired with critical, ethical thinking.
